latHint: Think a straight-A student with a gold star.
pivHint: In music, a SHARP raises a note by a half step. Describe a quick-thinking person and you might also call them SHARP, or ______.
winText: Quick on the uptake. SHARP was the pivot - a raised note to a clever, SMART mind.
lossText: SMART - quick to learn and clever. SHARP was the pivot: in music a SHARP raises a note, but a SHARP person is also clever, which is another way to say SMART.
